reason: Production converted the three same-date Production-authorized Research Objects into three bilingual V2 Research Center Publication Candidates. A governed editorial rework then replaced the repeated production skeleton with question-specific structures, replaced generic SVG cards with distinct professional editorial covers, and made evidence boundaries readable without exposing internal claim codes in general-reader prose.
reason_zh: Production 将三份同日且获授权的 Research Object 转换为三组双语 V2 Research Center Publication Candidate；随后经治理的编辑返工以问题专属结构替换重复生产骨架，以三张不同构图的专业编辑题图替换通用 SVG 卡片，并在普通读者正文中隐藏内部 Claim 编号、直接说明证据边界。

candidates.researchQuestion: When queued intent is removed after Core acceptance rather than after persistence, what execution-authority and recovery boundary should a durable agent runtime expose?
candidates.title: After the Queue Entry Disappears: Who Can Prove the Work Still Exists?
candidates.title_zh: 队列项消失以后：谁能证明这项工作仍然存在？

sections.heading: Cut the path at three failure points
sections.heading_zh: 用一次故障切开三个时刻

sections.heading: Custody transfers; correctness does not
sections.heading_zh: 真正转移的是责任，不是正确性

sections.heading: A receipt can narrow ambiguity, not abolish it
sections.heading_zh: 一条回执只能缩小歧义，不能消灭歧义

sections.heading: How this design should be falsified
sections.heading_zh: 这个设计应怎样被推翻

evidenceClaims.claim: The selected implementation admits queued user input when Core accepts it as a new turn or steer rather than waiting for later persistence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所选实现中，排队用户输入在 Core 接受其成为新一轮输入或转向输入时完成准入，而不是等待后续持久化。

evidenceClaims.claim: The queue entry is deleted after successful Core admission, while later persistence remains downstream of that handoff.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Queue Entry 在 Core Admission 成功后删除，而后续持久化仍处于这一交接边界之后。

evidenceClaims.claim: Acceptance and durable recovery evidence are distinct governance boundaries and should remain separately observable.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Acceptance 与持久恢复证据属于不同治理边界，应分别保持可观测。

evidenceClaims.claim: A durable accepted-occurrence receipt could reduce ambiguity after queue ownership transfers.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 持久的 Accepted-occurrence Receipt 可能缩小 Queue Ownership 转移后的恢复歧义。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument concerns durable agent work handoff generally and remains complete without first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: No named professional community adds a sufficiently distinct discussion angle beyond the complete Research Center analysis.

candidates.researchQuestion: How should an approval architecture unify decision vocabulary without conflating a user's requested consent scope with the policy state that was actually applied?
candidates.title: The User Clicked ‘Always Allow.’ What Did the System Actually Save?
candidates.title_zh: 用户点了“始终允许”，系统真正保存了什么？

sections.heading: “Always allow” passes through three gates
sections.heading_zh: 一次“始终允许”要穿过三道门

sections.heading: Shared types unify language, not authority
sections.heading_zh: 共享类型统一的是语言，不是权限

sections.heading: An audit record needs two answers
sections.heading_zh: 审计记录至少要同时回答两件事

sections.heading: Fail-closed matters most at semantic mismatches
sections.heading_zh: Fail-closed 最有价值的地方是语义错位

sections.heading: Dual records are not a tax on every approval
sections.heading_zh: 双记录不是所有审批的默认税

sections.heading: Acceptance must not stop at “the user consented”
sections.heading_zh: 验收不能停在“用户已经同意”

evidenceClaims.claim: The selected change moves MCP approvals onto shared ReviewDecision while retaining distinct current-request, session and MCP policy-amendment outcomes.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所选变更把 MCP Approval 迁移到共享 ReviewDecision，同时保留 Current-request、Session 与 MCP Policy-amendment 等不同结果。

evidenceClaims.claim: Approval-mode normalization can downgrade requested scope, and missing persistence capability can result in session-scoped behavior.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Approval-mode Normalization 可以降级请求范围，缺少持久能力时可能最终只形成 Session Scope。

evidenceClaims.claim: A shared decision type is best treated as intent vocabulary while effective authorization scope is recorded separately.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 共享 Decision Type 更适合作为意图词汇，而实际生效的 Authorization Scope 应独立记录。

evidenceClaims.claim: Returning requested and effective decisions plus a persistence acknowledgement could improve approval auditability.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 同时返回 Requested / Effective Decision 与持久确认，可能提升审批审计性。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns approval and policy architecture generally and does not require first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: The evidence supports a complete Research Center technical analysis, but no separate community framing adds enough distinct value today.

candidates.researchQuestion: How can a nested asynchronous tool runtime preserve ownership, cancellation and bounded failure without globally serializing independent sessions?
candidates.title: Concurrency Should Not Start With a Lock: The Smallest Safe Unit for Nested Callbacks
candidates.title_zh: 并发不该先问锁：嵌套 Callback 的最小安全单元

sections.heading: Turn “where should this return?” into “who still owns it?”
sections.heading_zh: 把“回到哪里”升级为“谁仍然拥有它”

sections.heading: A safe unit needs four boundaries
sections.heading_zh: 一个安全单元需要四条边界

sections.heading: A global lock taxes unrelated work
sections.heading_zh: 全局锁是组织复杂度的税

sections.heading: Local ownership stops being enough across a process boundary
sections.heading_zh: 一旦越过进程，局部所有权就不够了

sections.heading: Portable review criteria
sections.heading_zh: 一套可迁移的工程判据

evidenceClaims.claim: The selected gRPC path validates callback identity, execution or cell ownership, and enabled tools before nested callback admission.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所选 gRPC 路径在嵌套 Callback 准入前校验 Callback Identity、Execution / Cell Ownership 与 Enabled Tool。

evidenceClaims.claim: Active callback work carries cancellation ownership and pending work, identifiers and payloads are explicitly bounded.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 活动 Callback Work 持有取消所有权，同时 Pending Work、Identifier 与 Payload 均有显式边界。

evidenceClaims.claim: A tested large completion in one session does not block an independent session, so the tested safety path does not require one global callback lock.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 测试显示一个 Session 中的大型 Completion 不会阻塞独立 Session，因此被测试的安全路径不依赖单一全局 Callback Lock。

evidenceClaims.claim: Scoped ownership, revocation and resource bounds can preserve independent concurrency without global callback serialization.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Scoped Ownership、Revocation 与 Resource Bound 可以在不全局串行化 Callback 的情况下保留独立并发。

evidenceClaims.claim: Restart reconciliation may require durable occurrence identity and terminal evidence at the asynchronous handoff boundary.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 重启对账可能需要在异步交接边界增加 Durable Occurrence Identity 与 Terminal Evidence。

projectRelevance.rationale: The engineering judgment concerns nested asynchronous runtimes generally; first-party mapping would require separate implementation evidence.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center article already targets the relevant engineering audience and no separate community edition creates a sufficiently different question or evidence subset.
